tools.name: find_horses
tools.description: Find horses, jockeys and trainers by name, with their ids (for get_runner_form), most recently seen first.

tools.name: find_leagues
tools.description: Find leagues (competitions) of a sport and their ids, optionally by name or country (also matches official_name, the competition's official or Wikidata name where known). Free.

tools.name: find_teams
tools.description: Find teams by name, with their ids, country, venue and leagues.

tools.name: get_boxing_event
tools.description: One boxing event with every bout from the main event down: weight class, world titles at stake (WBA, WBC, IBF, WBO, Ring), fighters, result, method (KO, TKO, UD, SD, MD, RTD, DQ, TD, NC, draw), round, time, rounds scheduled.

tools.name: get_boxing_events
tools.description: Boxing events of the last and the current year from Wikipedia: fight cards and world title fights, with date, venue, city, status and the main event's winner (cite the attribution). The current world champions: get_standings with sport boxing.

tools.name: get_boxing_fighter
tools.description: A boxer (fighter_id): birth date, country, height, reach, stance and professional record (Wikipedia/Wikidata), world titles held now, latest bouts; or find boxers by name.

tools.name: get_golf_leaderboard
tools.description: A golf tournament's leaderboard: position (tied), to par, strokes per round, thru and today while live, earnings, missed cut or withdrawn, and per-player stats (birdies, eagles, driving distance and accuracy, greens in regulation, putts); holes=true adds hole-by-hole scores.

tools.name: get_golf_player
tools.description: A golfer's profile (country, birth date and place, PGA Tour rank) and season results from our leaderboards with events, wins, top 10s, cuts made and earnings (player_id); or find golfers by name.

tools.name: get_golf_tournaments
tools.description: Golf tournaments of the PGA Tour and LPGA by date: course, location, purse, status and the leader or winner. Leaderboards exist for the PGA Tour only. The season money list: get_standings with sport golf.

tools.name: get_h2h
tools.description: Head-to-head of two teams (soccer by default; any team sport with results: basketball, baseball, hockey, handball, volleyball, American football) over every meeting in our data (all competitions, no friendlies): won, drawn and lost from team_a's side (home_team_* fields = team_a), goals (the sport's

tools.name: get_league_facts
tools.description: What finished matches changed, newest first: the match story (comebacks, late winners, red cards), runs started or ended, table places and zones, each also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr). Use for 'what happened in this league today'. Facts only. Insights feature.

tools.name: get_live_matches
tools.description: Matches in play right now, with score and minute or period, and the TV channels showing them where known.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match: teams, score, status, events (goals, cards...), venue, referee; where known TV channels by country and, after the match, a highlights video link. Soccer adds timeline: the events normalised (minute, extra_minute, team home/away, kind goal, penalty, own_goal, missed_penalty, yellow, second

tools.name: get_match_briefing
tools.description: Ready briefing for one match (any sport but cricket): form, current streaks, home and away records, head-to-head, table position and gaps, stakes, schedule; for soccer also injuries, lineups, players one league appearance or goal short of a club milestone (milestone_next) and, after the match, the s

tools.name: get_match_details
tools.description: Detail of one match: statistics or box score, lineups, injuries (soccer: per player type, expected_return and matches_missed; null = not known, never guess), play-by-play, a cricket scorecard (batting, bowling, fall of wickets), rugby scoring events, esports maps and games with player lines, or the

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Matches (fixtures and results) by day or date range, optionally of one league, or one team's matches in every competition (team_id; without status or dates its latest results, then live, then next matches; with status scheduled only the next ones, with finished only the latest results). Without a da

tools.name: get_mma_event
tools.description: One MMA card from the main event down (weight class, fighters, winner, method, round, time, judges' scores, fight stats), or with bout_id one fight.

tools.name: get_mma_events
tools.description: MMA (UFC) fight cards by date: name, date, status and the main event with its result once known.

tools.name: get_mma_fighter
tools.description: An MMA fighter's record (wins, losses, draws, no contests; wins and losses by KO/TKO, submission, decision) from the bouts held since 2026, with the last fights; where Wikipedia/Wikidata has the fighter also the profile (birth date, height, reach, stance, nationality, weight class, team), the career

tools.name: get_motorsport_event
tools.description: One motorsport weekend with its sessions (practice, qualifying, sprint, race; start in UTC, status), or with session_id one session's results: position, driver, team, time or gap, laps, grid, pit stops, DNF/DNS/DSQ.

tools.name: get_motorsport_events
tools.description: Motorsport race weekends (Formula 1, MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, Formula 2, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR) by start date: round, name, country, circuit, dates, status and the race winner once known. With overview: every series with its season, next and last event.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Player profile: position, nationality, birth date, height, team, career and photo link where known; cricket and tennis also Wikidata values (birth date, height, batting or playing hand, bowling style, role, country; cite the attribution); tennis also the ATP/WTA rank, or with vs the head-to-head of

tools.name: get_race
tools.description: One horse race card: runners with number, horse, jockey, trainer, weight, rating, recent form where the feed has it, best current price and morning line; once settled the result (positions, starting prices, finish codes such as PU or F) and results_final.

tools.name: get_race_briefing
tools.description: Ready briefing for one horse race from our results: field size, distance, going, class, the favourite, each runner's form figures and last run, jockey and trainer strike rates over the last 30 days; after the race the winner, starting price and whether the favourite won. Each statement also as a sen

tools.name: get_races
tools.description: Horse races of a day (default today, UTC), optionally of one region or racecourse: off time, course, race name, distance, going, class, number of runners, status (NS, live, result_pending, FT).

tools.name: get_runner_form
tools.description: Last runs of a horse, jockey or trainer in our stored results, latest first: date, course, distance, going, position and field size, starting price; plus wins, top-three finishes and strike rate over those runs.

tools.name: get_snooker_darts_player
tools.description: A snooker or darts player (player_id): country, world ranking, birth date (Wikidata), titles and finals in the stored seasons, latest matches; or find players by name.

tools.name: get_snooker_darts_tournament
tools.description: A snooker or darts tournament with its whole draw (qualifying first, the final last): round, players, seeds, frames/legs/sets won, best of, three-dart averages where listed; snooker also the century breaks per player.

tools.name: get_snooker_darts_tournaments
tools.description: Snooker (World Snooker Tour ranking and invitational events) or darts (PDC majors, World Series, Players Championships, European Tour) tournaments of the current and last season from Wikipedia: dates, venue, prize fund, winner, final score. The world ranking: get_standings with sport snooker or dart

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: League table of a league; for soccer also the top scorers, most assists or most cards (top_scorers), every player's season statistics sorted by goals, assists, minutes, rating, xg or apps (player_stats), every team's season statistics with ranks such as the best defence (team_stats), the referees wi

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Team profile: country, founded, venue, leagues, logo link; rating: its Elo-style rating (rank of of in its league, matches_rated, rated_from, the last 10 changes); next: its next 5 matches in every competition (more: get_matches with team_id; fixture congestion: get_team_briefing). Soccer also coach

tools.name: get_team_briefing
tools.description: Ready briefing for one team (any sport but cricket; for tennis a player): form, streaks (overall, home, away; streak_season_best: the longest of the season), home and away record, table place and gaps, last and next match, congestion (games_last_7d, games_last_14d in every competition, rest_days fro

tools.name: get_transfers
tools.description: Soccer transfers from player profiles: player, from and to team, date, season, window (summer, winter, other by the date), type (transfer, loan, loan_return, free, promoted, swap, unknown) and fee_eur where the feed gives an amount (often null: say the fee is not known, never 0). tools.description: Sports available, with whether each has upcoming matches. Free. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_standings" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.
